question: Class vs Prototype — JavaScript mein actual inheritance kya use karta hai?
options: Prototype-based — class sirf syntactic sugar hai
explanation: JavaScript fundamentally prototypal inheritance based hai. Classes sirf syntactic sugar hain — under the hood sab prototypes pe kaam hota hai. __proto__ chain real inheritance hai.

question: 'this' ka value kaise determine hota hai?
options: Call site se — jahan function call hota hai usse decide hota hai
explanation: 'this' ka value call site pe depend karta hai — kaise call hua (method, function, new, arrow, bind). Default binding = window, method binding = object, new binding = naya object.

question: get/set accessor methods kab useful hote hain?
options: Property access pe custom logic chalani ho — validation, computed values
explanation: Getter/setter se property jaisa access hota hai but under logic hota hai — validation, transformation, lazy computation. obj.name se get, obj.name = 'x' se set.

question: Composition vs Inheritance — kab kya prefer karo?
explanation: Inheritance: Dog IS-A Animal. Composition: Car HAS-A Engine. Composition zyada flexible hai — tight coupling nahi hota, test karna aasan hai. Modern JS mein composition zyada preferred hai.

question: OOP ke 4 pillars kaunse hain?
explanation: 4 pillars: Encapsulation (data + methods bundled), Abstraction (complex details hidden), Inheritance (code reuse), Polymorphism (same interface, different behavior).
